description: The Földmegfigyelési Információs Rendszer (FIR) is Hungary's national Earth observation information system, built under the public administration development programme (KÖFOP-1.0.0-VEKOP-15-2017-00050) and run by the Earth Observation Operations Centre. Its eFöld remote sensing portal, read on 2026-09-28, lets anyone browse satellite images of Hungary taken by European Space Agency satellites without registering, while users who log in with the government Ügyfélkapu, eduID or a FIR account can save selected images to their own computer; the same site handles electronic permits for occasional airspace use, aerial remote sensing and defence building procedures. Coverage is national, with the image archive of the Sentinel missions and other sources as offered. Access is free, with registration for downloads; the terms are set in general conditions that were not read. Caveats: the page does not list products, processing levels or resolution, and the portal renders only with scripts. It supports hazard exposure analysis and emergency response mapping (floods, drought, fires) of Hungarian infrastructure from recent imagery. It complements the European-level Copernicus records; no other Hungarian Earth observation record is catalogued.
